_doc: Staging bank for VerifyRecall ('The Recognition Audit', brainstorm #11 - the Recovery closer). Wave-merge agent splices sharedPrompts[] into each of banks/{bambi,drone,sissy,circe}.json prompts[] (shr_ ids identical across all four). Grading is BINARY via `answer` (the compliant bucket index); recall.js owns the selection -> option-index mapping and never displays these labels as buttons. This item's HOME is RECOVERY: shr_cap_recall_rec is heat 0 with a verify* mechanicHint precisely so the engine's recovery-substitution plan (buildRecoverySubPlan) can pin it to a middle walk-down beat. See notes.

notes: MERGE: append the 5 sharedPrompts into every banks/<niche>.json prompts[]; ids are identical in all four (shr_ shared-baseline block, like shr_h0_* / shr_cap_grid_* / shr_cap_regen_*). Retune `tags` per bank ONLY if an axis needs its own archetype vocabulary (the 6-of-205 shr_h0 precedent) - the current tags are niche-neutral and vote A1/A2/A3/A5 via IntakeProfiler. DO NOT reorder options: recall.js maps its selection to a fixed option index - 0 denial-of-exposure (nothing selected / decline) / 1 recognition-consistent (only true-shown items, or 'yes') / 2 source-monitoring-error (a lure endorsed, or 'not sure') / 3 endorsement (the mantra card selected) - and the per-band `answer` names which bucket reads as compliant (all bands = 1: accurate recognition is the honest read; every OTHER path still lands and is scored as evidence the intake worked). The selection bitmask, latency, and which specific asset was called familiar have NO AnswerEvent channel (makeAnswerEvent exposes only chosenIndex/value/pickHeat), so those dimensions are folded into the option index alone (grid.js / regen.js precedent); do NOT extend contracts.js to carry them. BAND ROLES: cal is the PLANTED SEED - a straight, heat-0 'style acclimation' item that shows the lure-frame style HONESTLY ('confirm legibility') so the Recovery lures feel almost familiar; est/deep are light single-item recognition checks (yes / no / not sure, honest and completable because the shown card is a genuinely-shown payload); cli is the same check with 'not sure' REMOVED (yes / no); rec is the full old/new audit grid (real stimuli read back from core/mediaLog.js + never-shown lures in the seeded frame style + one plaintext mantra card from theme.praise). RECOVERY TONE: rec verdicts stay gentle/deadpan (sanctuary, invariant #3) and the file closes kindly ('audit complete. your file is consistent. thank you.'); ZERO corruption treatments in Recovery; timeoutMs is 0 (untimed). Recovery entry (shr_cap_recall_rec) is the item's ACTUAL delivery path, not merely forward-looking: it is heat 0 with a verify* mechanicHint exactly because buildRecoverySubPlan requires both, and it is chosen for a Recovery beat only if the family appears most-recently-used in the run trajectory (so the cal/est/deep/cli descent stages both rehearse the trap AND make the family eligible for the Recovery payoff). The engine falls straight through to the hardcoded CheckIn line if anything fails, so Recovery can never blank. VO rides q_<id> automatically (text = spoken line verbatim) - run build_intake_manifest.py after merge; each band has a distinct id so it gets a distinct heat-directed clip (cal straight -> cli curdled; rec heat-0 gentle). MEDIA: recall wants 15-20 sampled user assets vs the current ~10 (CAPTCHA_HANDOFF section 3) so the audit grid has enough real-vs-lure separation (old = ledger intersection, lures = sampled-but-never-shown); host-side sample bump only, not a PROTOCOL change. If the ledger is empty/unavailable recall.js degrades: it splits the sample deterministically into old/lure so the grid still reads. All niche-flavored verdict/UI strings (legibility-confirmed, denial, recognition-consistent, source-monitoring, endorsement, kind close, yes/no/not-sure labels) live in recall.js STRINGS keyed by niche (bambi/drone/sissy/circe); circe register respected everywhere (no exclamations, no diminutives, no em-dashes), and because Recovery is a sanctuary ALL niches stay gentle. The bank's nicheOverrides carry only circe PROMPT-text variants (register), matching the grid.js/regen.js split. SFX: recall reuses ONLY already-registered ids - 'verify-tick' (soft select tick), 'grid-settle' (cards settle in), 'stamp' (descent verdict thunk), 'captcha-verify-ok' + 'chime' (soft Recovery confirm + kind close). No new sfx ids and no voExtra, so sfxWanted/voExtra are empty. REGISTRATION (later wave, when this item is activated): add `verifyrecall` is ALREADY in the Mechanic enum (core/contracts.js) as a next-tier placeholder - only add './recall.js' under verifyrecall to MECHANIC_MODULE in render/captcha/index.js to wire the dispatcher; no audio.js change needed (all ids already registered).
